final_template:
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role for third-party security auditing platform access"
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote-arn" {
  description = "ARN of the principal allowed to assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external-id" {
  description = "External ID for sts:ExternalId condition in the trust policy"
  type        = string
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_iam_policy" "view_only_access" {
  name = "ViewOnlyAccess"
}

data "aws_iam_policy" "security_audit" {
  name = "SecurityAudit"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "role_trust" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote-arn]
    }

    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external-id]
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "inline_policy" {
  # Statement 1: Read-only access across many services on all resources
  statement {
    sid    = "ReadOnlyAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "acm:Describe*",
      "acm:Get*",
      "acm:List*",
      "apigateway:GET",
      "backup:Get*",
      "backup:List*",
      "backup:Describe*",
      "cloudtrail:Get*",
      "cloudtrail:List*",
      "cloudtrail:Describe*",
      "codebuild:BatchGet*",
      "codebuild:List*",
      "cognito-identity:Describe*",
      "cognito-identity:Get*",
      "cognito-identity:List*",
      "connect:Describe*",
      "connect:Get*",
      "connect:List*",
      "dynamodb:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:GetItem",
      "dynamodb:List*",
      "dynamodb:Query",
      "dynamodb:Scan",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ecr:Describe*",
      "ecr:Get*",
      "ecr:List*",
      "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability",
      "ecr:BatchGetImage",
      "eks:Describe*",
      "eks:List*",
      "efs:Describe*",
      "efs:List*",
      "emr:Describe*",
      "emr:List*",
      "ssm:Describe*",
      "ssm:Get*",
      "ssm:List*",
      "glacier:Describe*",
      "glacier:Get*",
      "glacier:List*",
      "glue:Get*",
      "glue:List*",
      "glue:BatchGet*",
      "health:Describe*",
      "kafka:Describe*",
      "kafka:Get*",
      "kafka:List*",
      "kendra:Describe*",
      "kendra:Get*",
      "kendra:List*",
      "kinesisanalytics:Describe*",
      "kinesisanalytics:Get*",
      "kinesisanalytics:List*",
      "kinesisvideo:Describe*",
      "kinesisvideo:Get*",
      "kinesisvideo:List*",
      "kms:Describe*",
      "kms:Get*",
      "kms:List*",
      "lambda:Get*",
      "lambda:List*",
      "logs:Describe*",
      "logs:Get*",
      "logs:List*",
      "profile:Get*",
      "profile:List*",
      "s3:Get*",
      "s3:List*",
      "ses:Describe*",
      "ses:Get*",
      "ses:List*",
      "voiceid:Describe*",
      "voiceid:Get*",
      "voiceid:List*",
      "wafv2:Describe*",
      "wafv2:Get*",
      "wafv2:List*",
      "wisdom:Get*",
      "wisdom:List*",
      "macie2:Describe*",
      "macie2:Get*",
      "macie2:List*",
      "identitystore:Describe*",
      "identitystore:Get*",
      "identitystore:List*",
      "sso-directory:Describe*",
      "sso-directory:Get*",
      "sso-directory:List*",
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:Get*",
      "cloudwatch:List*"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Statement 2: EBS snapshot creation and metadata
  statement {
    sid    = "EbsSnapshotManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CopySnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Statement 3: Tag creation on EC2 snapshots in any region
  statement {
    sid    = "Ec2SnapshotTagging"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateTags"
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:snapshot/*"]
  }

  # Statement 4: KMS alias creation on the "wizKey" alias and on any KMS key
  statement {
    sid    = "KmsAliasCreation"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:CreateAlias"
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/*"
    ]
  }

  # Statement 5: KMS key policy actions on keys tagged with wiz=auto-gen-cmk
  statement {
    sid    = "KmsKeyPolicyManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  # Statement 6: Snapshot deletion and modification on snapshots tagged with wiz=auto-gen-snapshot
  statement {
    sid    = "SnapshotTaggedDeletion"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
      "ec2:ResetSnapshotAttribute"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  # Statement 7: Explicit Deny for s3:GetObject on all resources
  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessS3"
    effect = "Deny"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access" {
  name               = var.rolename
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.role_trust.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = data.aws_iam_policy.view_only_access.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = data.aws_iam_policy.security_audit.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "wiz_custom" {
  name   = "WizCustomPolicy"
  role   = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.inline_policy.json
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TERRAFORM & PROVIDER REQUIREMENTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0"
    }
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VARIABLES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
variable "enable" {
  description = "Master toggle to enable or disable the entire security group management module."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_new_sg" {
  description = "When true, a new security group is created. When false, rules are attached to an existing security group."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "existing_sg_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing security group to attach rules to. Required when create_new_sg is false."
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  description = "VPC ID for the new security group. If not provided and create_new_sg is true, a fallback VPC with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 is created."
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "prefix_list_enabled" {
  description = "Toggle to enable creation of a managed prefix list."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# Variables passed to the labels module
variable "name" {
  description = "Name for the resource (used by the labels module)."
  type        = string
  default     = "app"
}

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name (e.g., dev, prod)."
  type        = string
  default     = "dev"
}

variable "namespace" {
  description = "Namespace (e.g., company or project abbreviation)."
  type        = string
  default     = "mycompany"
}

variable "stage" {
  description = "Stage (e.g., dev, test, prod)."
  type        = string
  default     = "dev"
}

variable "attributes" {
  description = "Additional attributes for resource naming."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Extra tags to apply to all resources."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

variable "ingress_rules" {
  description = <<-EOT
    List of ingress rule objects. Each object supports:
    - description (optional)
    - from_port (number)
    - to_port (number)
    - protocol (string, e.g. tcp, udp, -1)
    - cidr_blocks (optional list of strings)
    - self (optional bool, default false)
    - source_security_group_id (optional string)
    - prefix_list_id (optional string, defaults to the created prefix list if available)
  EOT
  type = list(object({
    description              = optional(string)
    from_port                = number
    to_port                  = number
    protocol                 = string
    cidr_blocks              = optional(list(string))
    self                     = optional(bool, false)
    source_security_group_id = optional(string)
    prefix_list_id           = optional(string)
  }))
  default = []
}

variable "egress_rules" {
  description = <<-EOT
    List of egress rule objects. Same structure as ingress_rules.
  EOT
  type = list(object({
    description              = optional(string)
    from_port                = number
    to_port                  = number
    protocol                 = string
    cidr_blocks              = optional(list(string))
    self                     = optional(bool, false)
    source_security_group_id = optional(string)
    prefix_list_id           = optional(string)
  }))
  default = []
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LABELS MODULE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
module "labels" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/sohanyadav/terraform-aws-labels.git?ref=v1.0.0"

  name        = var.name
  environment = var.environment
  attributes  = var.attributes
  # The module does not accept namespace, stage, or tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOCAL VALUES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
locals {
  # Tags constructed from the labels module's output (name) plus extra tags
  tags = merge(var.tags, {
    Name = module.labels.name
  })

  # Determine the VPC ID to use for a new security group
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id != null ? var.vpc_id : (var.enable && var.create_new_sg ? aws_vpc.fallback[0].id : null)

  # Security group ID to use for rule attachment
  sg_id = var.create_new_sg ? (var.enable ? aws_security_group.this[0].id : null) : var.existing_sg_id
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FALLBACK VPC (only when creating a new SG and no VPC ID is provided)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_vpc" "fallback" {
  count = var.enable && var.create_new_sg && var.vpc_id == null ? 1 : 0

  cidr_block           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NEW SECURITY GROUP (only when create_new_sg is true)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_security_group" "this" {
  count = var.enable && var.create_new_sg ? 1 : 0

  name        = "${module.labels.name}-sg"
  description = "Security group managed by Terraform"
  vpc_id      = local.vpc_id

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MANAGED PREFIX LIST (optional)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_ec2_managed_prefix_list" "this" {
  count = var.enable && var.prefix_list_enabled ? 1 : 0

  name           = "${module.labels.name}-prefix-list"
  address_family = "IPv4"
  max_entries    = 5

  # Entries can be added via a separate resource or variable – none by default.
  # This block intentionally left empty to allow external management.

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# INGRESS RULES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "ingress" {
  for_each = var.enable ? { for idx, rule in var.ingress_rules : idx => rule } : {}

  description = each.value.description
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = each.value.from_port
  to_port     = each.value.to_port
  protocol    = each.value.protocol

  # Only one of the following should be set per rule. Self takes precedence.
  self                     = each.value.self ? true : null
  source_security_group_id = each.value.self ? null : each.value.source_security_group_id
  cidr_blocks              = each.value.self ? null : each.value.cidr_blocks
  prefix_list_ids          = each.value.self ? null : (
    each.value.prefix_list_id != null && each.value.prefix_list_id != ""
    ? [each.value.prefix_list_id]
    : (var.prefix_list_enabled ? [aws_ec2_managed_prefix_list.this[0].id] : null)
  )

  security_group_id = local.sg_id

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EGRESS RULES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "egress" {
  for_each = var.enable ? { for idx, rule in var.egress_rules : idx => rule } : {}

  description = each.value.description
  type        = "egress"
  from_port   = each.value.from_port
  to_port     = each.value.to_port
  protocol    = each.value.protocol

  # Only one of the following should be set per rule. Self takes precedence.
  self                     = each.value.self ? true : null
  source_security_group_id = each.value.self ? null : each.value.source_security_group_id
  cidr_blocks              = each.value.self ? null : each.value.cidr_blocks
  prefix_list_ids          = each.value.self ? null : (
    each.value.prefix_list_id != null && each.value.prefix_list_id != ""
    ? [each.value.prefix_list_id]
    : (var.prefix_list_enabled ? [aws_ec2_managed_prefix_list.this[0].id] : null)
  )

  security_group_id = local.sg_id

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
